answer: MyNumerologyCharts is designed for people who want more than a unexplained number. It displays the calculation method, handles master numbers consistently, avoids fear-based wording and keeps the core tool free from advertising.
sections:
Why do numerology calculators disagree?

Different tools may reduce dates in different orders, preserve different master numbers or use different name systems. This platform identifies the method on each result and explains the rules.

What does privacy-first mean here?

Birth details are processed in the browser. The app does not put a name or birth date into a public URL, and local profiles remain on the device unless the user chooses another action.

title: Numerology Calculator FAQ | MyNumerologyCharts
description: Numerology calculator FAQ covering accuracy, master numbers, birth names, privacy, different results and personal cycles.
answer: The numerology calculator FAQ explains the most common questions about formulas, names, master numbers, saved information and interpretation. Numerology is treated as a traditional reflective practice, not as scientific or professional advice.
sections:
Why does another calculator show a different Life Path Number?

Another calculator may add every digit at once, reduce the month, day and year separately, or retain different master numbers. Open the Calculation Explorer to see the method used here and compare each step.

Should I use my birth name or current name?

Traditional Pythagorean numerology commonly uses the full birth name for core name numbers. A current or preferred name may be explored separately, but it should be clearly labelled rather than silently substituted.

Are numerology results scientifically proven?

No. Numerology is a traditional symbolic system used for education, entertainment and personal reflection. It should not replace medical, legal, financial or psychological advice.

Does the app save my date of birth?

The calculation itself runs in your browser. A birth date is saved only if you deliberately save a local profile on the device. It is not included in analytics or public share links.

What are master numbers?

Master numbers are compound totals, commonly 11, 22 and 33, that some numerology traditions retain rather than immediately reducing. The methodology page explains exactly where this app retains them.

title: Numerology Calculation Methodology | MyNumerologyCharts
description: Numerology calculation methodology for Life Path, name values, master numbers, Pinnacles, Challenges and personal cycles.
answer: The MyNumerologyCharts methodology defines one consistent Pythagorean calculation system, identifies where master numbers are retained and records the exact formula version used by the app. Every result links back to these rules.
sections:
Which letter chart is used?

1A J S
2B K T
3C L U
4D M V
5E N W
6F O X
7G P Y
8H Q Z
9I R

How are master numbers handled?

The launch formula retains 11, 22 and 33 as final values where the calculation explicitly permits master numbers. Intermediate rules are shown in each calculation trace. Compound values can still be inspected before reduction.

How are names normalised?

Latin letters A to Z are mapped after Unicode normalisation. Spaces, hyphens and apostrophes are ignored for totals but preserved for display. Users with non-Latin names receive a clear notice that transliteration may change the result.

What is the formula version?

The launch calculation engine uses formula version 1.0. Saved results display this version so future methodology changes can be traced.
